reviews.review:
Great little game that deserves more attention! 

It's somewhat similar to games like Vampire Survivors, mixed with a little bullet hell. Your run around fighting enemies, collecting XP, leveling up, etc. 

What's unique about Triple Swap Tower is that you don't control one entity, but three. Each has a differnet attack pattern (eg: horizontal, diagonal, short vs long range, homing, etc.) In a way, it would be kind of like if only one weapon was active at a time in VS, and you swapped between them to make use of different attack patterns. The other key point here is that your party members have stamina and have to cooldown, so you are forced to swap.

It's a satisfying game loop: fight enemies until you reach a boss, then rest up in town and recover health / get items / level up, then off to the next boss. Repeat for 4 bosses and then you're off to face a final boss. Between runs, you'll unlock new party members with their own passives and attack patterns.

The low-res pixel art style is a perfect fit. Everything here is super punchy and satisfying, despite being visually simple.

A couple things I felt could be improved:

- The game is visually busy, with enemies leaving lots of splatters on the floor. I would occasionally lose track of my character on the screen.

- The controls took a bit of getting used to for me. I feel the game could be easier to play with VS style auto-attacking, although I suspect it may not work well with the stamina system

Lots of different bosses, unlockable characters, etc. Excited to dig in some more!
